description: Canonical token values for the wireframe design system. Values are taken from the JSX source (canonical); see notes for derivations.

extras.radius.message.note: JSX: message bubbles are borderRadius 8 (the shell's chrome radius, not radius.default 6).

extras.radius.checkbox.note: No checkbox in the JSX. A 20px box rounds at 4, a step below the 6px input radius, so it stays crisp at small size.

extras.radius.icon.note: No icon glyphs in the JSX. The 12-16px glyph squares in icon and nav placeholders round at 2.

extras.color.surface_disabled.note: Disabled card surface used by the SVG library (card-disabled); not in the JSX. Listed in rulebook_check's wireframe palette.

color.surface_inverse.note: JSX user message bubble: #424242 fill with #FFFFFF text.

color.text_placeholder.note: JSX: 'Placeholder text in #BDBDBD' (same value as muted/disabled).

color.border_input.note: JSX input contract: 1.5px #E0E0E0 stroke; focus stroke 1.5px #424242. Contrast fix (#7): #E0E0E0 -> #949494. Inputs are white on a white surface; the 1.5px stroke is what identifies them (WCAG 1.4.11); minimum OKLCH lightness change that passes, hue and chroma kept. Equal to text_muted, which keeps the wireframe palette to its existing greys. [color.border_input on color.surface 1.32:1 -> 3.03:1 (min 3.0:1)]

color.focus_ring.note: JSX selection model: 'Focus outline 2px solid #424242 offset 2px'.

space.md.note: Not named in JSX; card padding is 16px, so md = 16. xs/sm/lg/xl picked from allowed_steps.

type.label.note: JSX stat card label: 12px, 600, UPPER, 0.05em tracking.

motion.fast.note: Neutral JSX .snd send: 'transition: opacity 0.12s' (CSS default ease). Selection is instant. exit_ms is derived (~0.7 x enter, the fine-design ratio): the JSX has no exit animations; React unmounts instantly.

motion.moderate.note: Neutral JSX .ci list rows: 'fadeSlideUp 0.2s ease', 6px travel, 40ms stagger. exit_ms is derived (~0.7 x enter, the fine-design ratio): the JSX has no exit animations; React unmounts instantly.

motion.slow.note: Neutral JSX .mi messages: 'fadeSlideUp 0.2s ease', 70ms stagger; equal to moderate. Also the tier of the derived modal/drawer/command palette declarations. exit_ms is derived (~0.7 x enter, the fine-design ratio): the JSX has no exit animations; React unmounts instantly.

motion.expressive.note: Not used by the JSX. A neutral step beyond slow on ease-out, no spring (a lo-fi wireframe does not bounce).

motion.reduced_motion.note: The JSX has no prefers-reduced-motion query: every animation (including the staggered entrances) plays regardless of the user setting. Reduced motion keeps opacity and drops travel.

color.text_muted.note: Contrast fix (#7): #BDBDBD -> #949494. minimum OKLCH lightness change that passes, hue and chroma kept. [color.text_muted on color.surface 1.88:1 -> 3.03:1 (min 3.0:1)]

color.warning.note: Contrast fix (#7): #E65100 -> #D14900. White status text like every other wireframe status; the fill moves instead (minimum OKLCH lightness change that passes, hue and chroma kept, chroma clamped 0.197 -> 0.183 to stay in sRGB). [color.warning_foreground on color.warning 3.79:1 -> 4.5:1 (min 4.5:1)]
